name: FeatherPad
description:
FeatherPad is a lightweight, feature-rich plain text editor written in C++ and Qt. Designed for high speed and minimal resource usage, it handles large text files with ease while offering a clean, distraction-free interface.

Features:
- Syntax highlighting for dozens of programming, markup, and scripting languages
- Tabbed document interface with drag-and-drop support and split views
- Search and replace with full regular expression support
- Auto-detection of text encoding and line ending formats
- Session management, side-pane navigation, and customizable color schemes
